terrain: A moat runs from the top left corner down to the bottom centre and is crossed only at {5,4}, the gate in the centre. The defender's walls stand to the right of it: one along the top edge between a tower at its left end and another at the top centre, a short stretch flanked by two towers on the town side at each end of the moat, and another round the bottom right corner with two towers. Stairs go up onto the walls at the top left, the top centre, the top right, the bottom centre and the bottom right.
attacker: The attacker's spawn points run down the left edge, on open ground outside the moat.
defender: The defender's spawn points spread through the town, seven of them on the towers and walls.
